scope: 30 reserved paired bank rows in two layouts; DEV, no independent TEST. 2 skills x 2 maps x 2 batches of 1485. Real 20 consecutive 5 ms world-y force intervals after first ascending free contact; report exposure.
controls: nominal medoid from primary-calibration root IDs on each map
C empirical conditional handback distribution from nearest five calibration initial states
C-R same prefix and offline C choice, one measured handback query
budget: All plan methods have access to three approaches x three departures; fixed policy ignores forecast; C shadow queries the same three live candidates and commits its original command; C-R can switch once. Forecast wall latency recorded per affected batch; sim clock holds during decision. Forced-choice with unsafe candidates kept.
criteria: Paired physical outcomes, fallback/no feasible reported. C-R net rescued minus lost <=2 distinct layout/root/task units is auxiliary; force, skill and section reported separately. Alpha and final blind TEST deferred.
